policy.condition: Every source RGB population standard deviation is at most 0.05

selectionHistory: The cutoff was selected after the Crescent moon print-SSIM loss and inspection of the already frozen contrast features. It was not selected on held-out pictures. The 0.32 finder trial did not close the loss; the first requested 65% trial remained internally clamped to 60%. The corrected 65% trial passed 480 reads and gained +0.0133369 phone / +0.00589916 print mean SSIM.
retentionRule: Recheck every completed very-low-contrast Square and three unchanged-domain pixel controls. Other paths keep their prior correction share and all defaults. Measure every key with either mode missing; preserve any duplicate fresh detail observation, with recheck priority fixed before timing.
timing: Segmented series; retain original per-mode observations except predeclared affected rechecks and controls. Keep all superseded rows, cold starts, and interruptions.

postCaptureQualification.scope: All original conditions partitioned across local Node workers after the appearance clock ends. The parent awaits every condition before the next measurement.
postCaptureQualification.implementationProof: The default serial assessment remains unchanged after removing an optional condition-list parameter; the paired clock body is unchanged after removing the scheduler import and provenance entries.
